Neither g15 v5 nor v6 has a lands or findingDisposition field, and no finding has landed in this lineage. The no-cell branch excludes the D-236 file-08 SATISFIED act and CONTESTED D-272. Live readiness, special row tokens, and DR-119 SATISFIED remain unchanged; the prohibited D-056 gates-2-and-3 claim is expressly disclaimed. The draft authorizes only append-only COORD adoption after CONSENT.
